articles.title: Trump signs order calling for spacing out childhood vaccines, against medical groups’ guidance
articles.description:
Public health experts have raised concerns that spacing out shots as Trump suggests can lead to an increased risk that children become infected with a vaccine-preventable disease before returning for another visit.

The post Trump signs order calling for spacing out childhood vaccines, against medical groups’ guidance appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Trump signs order on August 10, 2026, to space out childhood vaccines.
Public health experts warn this could increase infection risks for Boston children.
Local parents may face delays in vaccinations, impacting community immunity levels.

articles.title: A Fall River 911 call said a man had killed his parents and had children hostage. It turned out to be a hoax.
articles.description:
An investigation into the origin of the call is ongoing, Fall River police said.

The post A Fall River 911 call said a man had killed his parents and had children hostage. It turned out to be a hoax. appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Fall River police responded to a hoax 911 call about a double homicide and hostage situation.
The investigation into the false call is currently ongoing, according to local authorities.
Residents are urged to remain vigilant as such hoaxes can divert emergency resources.

articles.title: Patriots trade OL Caedan Wallace to Dolphins
articles.description:
New England sent Wallace and a 2029 seventh-round pick to Miami in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round pick.

The post Patriots trade OL Caedan Wallace to Dolphins appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Patriots traded OL Caedan Wallace to Dolphins on August 10, 2026.
New England received a 2028 sixth-round pick and sent a 2029 seventh-round pick.
This trade may affect the Patriots' offensive line depth for the upcoming season.
